description: This file defines an abstract class 'StyleBase' within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It provides protected static methods for style value identification and XML attribute retrieval, serving as a base for handling styles in XML-based spreadsheet formats.

classes.name: StyleBase
classes.description: An abstract class providing utility methods for style handling in XML formats within PhpSpreadsheet.

methods.name: identifyFixedStyleValue
methods.description: Checks if the given style attribute value matches any value in the style list, case-insensitively, and standardizes the value if matched.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves the attributes of a specified node from a SimpleXMLElement, returning an empty SimpleXMLElement if the node is null.
